visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female presenter with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a vibrant yellow and green traditional Chinese qipao with pink floral embroidery and pearl-accented hair accessories, stands against a festive red studio backdrop featuring traditional lattice windows and hanging lanterns. She speaks directly to the camera with a warm smile, periodically bringing her hands together in a respectful greeting (gongxi) and gesturing outwards to emphasize her points. Golden sycee (yuanbao) icons are superimposed at the bottom left and right corners. (2) The scene transitions to a full-frame graphic animation with a deep red background adorned with floating gold particles and stylized clouds. A cute, 3D-rendered cartoon snake wearing a red traditional jacket and holding a glowing red lantern appears on the right side. Large golden traditional Chinese characters and English text are centered on the screen, celebrating the upcoming Year of the Snake.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks with a cheerful and engaging delivery style, maintaining a moderate pace and clear articulation. The vocal tone is consistently warm and informative, characteristic of a blessing or greeting. Background music features traditional Chinese acoustic instruments including Guzheng and a soft flute melody, set to a steady, mid-tempo folk rhythm with light percussive accents. The acoustic environment is studio-clean with zero background noise. (2) As the visual transitions to the animation, the vocal narration concludes while the festive BGM continues to swell slightly in volume. The traditional instrumentation maintains the celebratory mood, with the Erhu and Guzheng providing a rich, melodic texture. A subtle bell chime or digital stinger SFX marks the final graphic appearance before the audio fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a cultural educational and celebratory greeting for 'God Sending Day' (Song Shen Ri) preceding the Lunar New Year. The presenter explains the significance of the day, suggesting specific rituals like preparing sweets for deities and performing a deep house cleaning to clear old energy. It concludes with warm blessings for prosperity and luck in the Year of the Snake (2025).
